content: Here's some dancing. See those guys stomping, clapping and shouting? They're practicing step-dancing.
It sounds cool. The rhythms look really difficult.
They basically turn their bodies into drums. There's a national step competition every year.
Well, black people are supposed to be great dancers.
Wen! That's only a stereotype. Like all Asians are supposed to be math geniuses. I'm not a great dancer, and you said you failed calculus.
